liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet-Fire is a classic west coast version, unhurried and fully developed, with Garcia fully committed to his solos; Scarlet solo is intense, before the jam returns to the 'Wind in the Willows' tease [9][12]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Fire is described as a great, tribal version [13]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Wheel is called inspiring; reviewer also praises Brent, the Bertha opener and the drums [13]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Black Peter is called suitable [18]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): The Sunshine Daydream section is rip-snorting, with Bob wailing so hard Donna is pushed back [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-12-27.mtx.sb18a.34705.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 137 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears a subtle polyrhythmic swing throughout this matrix recording; Matrix sounds great with a good mix and very clear vocals; Reviewer likes the audience/soundboard blend made by Chris Chappell's Sick Bits mixes [1][9][11][14]
- **gd1982-12-27.sbd.ladner.32134.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 132 min [2]. Said about its sound: Poor recording, perhaps a monitor mix, with missing instruments and a silent crowd [2]
- **gd1982-12-27.147920.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 138 min [3]. Said about its sound: The start of U.S. Blues is muffled [3]
- **gd1982-12-27.senn441.koucky.ladner.77463.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 132 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Minor hiss in the quietest parts remains, with no noise reduction applied [5]
- **gd1982-12-27.set2.sbd.miller.95954.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 78 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [6]. Said about its sound: Source is otherwise poor-sounding, but this PCM transfer is considered a great one [19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer considers the second set list one of the all-time greats [10]
- Reviewer, an East coaster, attended and found the show sloppy but special; liked Garcia's GTB [16]
- Seeder, who attended, recalls tons of energy and power that the tape does not convey [2]
- Prefers this Scarlet-Fire to the Manor Downs one: more homey, heartfelt, less tweaky [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-12-27.mtx.sb18a.34705.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky and Chris Ladner and Chris Chappell; source: See info file [1]. Also: Matrix is one of Chris Chappell's 'Sick Bits' mixes; Bill Koucky asked for a matrix; Chris Ladner cleaned the soundboard for set 1, and a Clugston source was used for set 2 [1][11]
- **gd1982-12-27.sbd.ladner.32134.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky and Chris Ladner; source: SBD > MC(?) > Cx > DAT > DAT from Dr. Bruce Fried [2]. Also: Poor cassette-to-DAT editing, including dead air after Big River; seeder also has a first-generation Sennheiser 441 audience tape [2]
- **gd1982-12-27.147920.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M [3]
- **gd1982-12-27.senn441.koucky.ladner.77463.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bill Koucky; transferred by Bill Koucky and Chris Ladner; source: FOB Sennheiser 441s > Sony D5 > Sony D5 (first gen CM) [5]
- **gd1982-12-27.set2.sbd.miller.95954.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> PCM [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-12-31 Oakland Auditorium Arena, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-12-31-oakland-auditorium-arena-oakland-ca-usa/) [21]
